Q.6 Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.
Its impossible to conduct truly causal research on media consumption and suicide
questions.solution: A)It’sshould be used instead ofItsbecause "Its" is a possessive pronoun, used when something belongs to or is associated with something that has already been mentioned. "It's", on the other hand, is a contraction of "it is" or "it has". In this sentence, we are not indicating possession, but rather making a statement (it is impossible), so "It's" is the correct form to use.

questions.q:
Q. 9 Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.
What is the price of this fancy dress pink?
questions.solution: A) The error in the sentence is in the arrangement of the words. The correct sentence should be: "What is the price of this pink fancy dress?" The adjective (pink) should come before the noun (fancy dress) it is describing. In English, adjectives usually precede the noun they modify.

questions.q:
Q. 18 Fill in the blank with the most suitable word.
The humour of the gods is cruel; or ______ they see more than we do
questions.solution:
C) 'perhaps'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि वाक्य का अर्थ इस बात को संकेत कर रहा है कि देवताओं को शायद इंसानों से अधिक ज्ञान होता है। यहाँ "The humour of the gods is cruel; or ______ they see more than we do" में 'perhaps' शब्द संभावना को व्यक्त करता है कि यह सच हो सकता है कि देवता अधिक जानते हैं, जो कि अन्य विकल्पों ('unlikely', 'odds', 'however') की तुलना में अधिक सही बैठता है। इसलिए, "perhaps" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।
• 'perhaps' should be used because the sentence implies the possibility that the gods might know more than humans. Here, in "The humour of the gods is cruel; or ______ they see more than we do", the word 'perhaps' expresses the possibility that it might be true that the gods know more, which fits better than the other options ('unlikely', 'odds', 'however'). Thus, "perhaps" would be the most appropriate choice.

questions.q:
Q. 19 Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.
I didn't have times to watch the whole movie
questions.solution: A) The underlined part of the sentence, "times to watch", is grammatically incorrect. The correct form should be "time to watch". The noun "time" is uncountable in this context, and it should be followed by an infinitive verb form ("to watch").

In the following passage some of the words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the correct answer for the given blank out of the four alternatives.
According to the Integrated Taxonomic Information System (ITIS) there are more than 60 (1)______ of rat, which means they come in all sizes. They are (2)_____ 5 inches (12 centimeters), or longer, according to Encyclopedia Britannica. Q. 21 Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.solution:
C) The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1 is C. "species".
यहां context चूहों के classification की चर्चा कर रहा है। Biology में, Species एक ऐसे organism को define करने का शब्द है जो single और distinct होता है।
The context here is discussing rat classification. In biology, species is the term used to define a single, distinct type of organism
